mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.00% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financial conditions compressing near-term discounting of equity cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.00% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns during Fed rate hikes are not statistically different from the mean of the prior 12 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 for two consecutive months coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates on labor market weakness.
failure_condition: During the same 60-day window, 20-day forward returns remain positive in at least 70% of sub-windows where the trigger occurs (robustness test).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly exceeds 3.0% in the following month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days tend to be positive as market anticipates a possible rate pause or cut.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL surprises above +3.00% in the next month
failure_condition: Across 50 such surprise inflation events, the 5-day forward return is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 2% for three months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > -2.00% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: During 10 such contraction episodes, the 20-day forward return is not significantly different from the mean of the prior 20-day window (bootstrap p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in residential mortgage applications (HOUST) below 1.5 million units in a month, followed by a subsequent rise, coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as the signal of easing housing market stress and potential rate cut anticipation.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1,500,000 units and then rebounds in the same month
failure_condition: Across 15 such events, the 20-day forward return during the rebound window is not statistically higher than the 5-day pre-drop average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months in a regime of steady GDP growth, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be positive as market expects continued job creation and wage growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.00% for two consecutive months and GDP growth is positive
failure_condition: During 10 such episodes, the 60-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 30-day pre-trigger average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rebound in retail sales activity proxy (RSAFS) above the prior month's level in the same month signals demand recovery, which is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
Note: Due to proxy limitations, this sketch is omitted. Instead, here is a valid interaction-driven demand signal using available proxies.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month AND RSAFS > previous month in the same month
failure_condition: During 20 such recovery windows, the 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day pre-recovery average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 6-month moving average of industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for three consecutive months in a regime of negative core CPI inflation, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be negative due to persistent supply-side constraints and weak demand.
candidate_trigger: 6-month INDPRO MA < 100 for three consecutive months AND core CPIAUCSL < 3.00% (monthly) for the same period
regime_hint: Persistent supply shock with deflationary backdrop
failure_condition: Across 10 such episodes, the 60-day forward return is not significantly different from the mean of the prior 60 days (bootstrap p > 0.05).
